## Problem Statement
What problem does this feature solve? What's the pain point?

## Proposed Solution
Describe your ideal solution. Be specific.

## Alternatives Considered
What other approaches did you consider? Why this one?

## Scope & Impact
- [ ] Small (UI text, config change, typo fix)
- [ ] Medium (new command, cipher, achievement)
- [ ] Large (new system, major refactor, new UI)

## Implementation Ideas (optional)
Any technical thoughts on implementation?

## Additional Context
Mockups, references, related issues, etc.

## Checklist
- [ ] I searched existing issues/PRs
- [ ] This fits the game's scope (terminal mystery, not MMO)
- [ ] I'm open to discussion and iteration
